networks.name: voice_trip_concierge
networks.description: Plans a multi-day trip, revises one stop, and watches hours, weather, and drive time.
sample_queries: Plan 3 days in Seattle for food and parks
Swap the art museum for a market
Check whether anything is closed or too far

networks.name: city_notes
networks.description: Peer network that refuses to invent local events.

llm_router.note: The default router is on-page and deterministic, so the host pays nothing. Visitors may bring an OpenAI-compatible router, model, and key. The main trip screen uses Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference for intent and narration when that project is configured.

peer_policy.note: The runtime asks before contacting any origin, including this site's city_notes network. Approval lasts for the page session.

agent_mcp.reason: This static deployment has no public MCP facade. Other sites load the published network in their own browser.
